description: List YOUR saved rigs, newest first, optionally narrowed by `query` (matches the                  name/summary). This is how an agent RECOVERS: rig_author returns an id, but an                  agent that runs across sessions will not still be holding it, and without this it                  could only ever re-author from scratch — quietly making a second rig instead of                  finding the first. Owner-scoped. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

query.description: Narrow by name/summary. Omit for everything you own.

name: rig_search
title: Find the rigs you own
